message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('src/md4c.c').read_text()
s=s.replace('static int
md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
{
    MD_BLOCK* block;', 'static int
md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
{
    if(line->type < 0 || line->type > 10) { fprintf(stderr,"INVALID type=%d data=%u enf=%d beg=%u end=%u indent=%u\n", line->type,line->data,line->enforce_new_block,line->beg,line->end,line->indent); abort(); }
    if(line->type==0 || line->type==4 || line->type==10) { fprintf(stderr,"UNEXPECTED type=%d data=%u enf=%d beg=%u end=%u indent=%u\n", line->type,line->data,line->enforce_new_block,line->beg,line->end,line->indent); }
    MD_BLOCK* block;')
Path('/tmp/md4c_check.c').write_text(s)
PY
cc -O2 -I src /tmp/fuzz_bad.c /tmp/md4c_check.c src/md4c-html.c src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz_check && timeout 20 /tmp/fuzz_check > /tmp/fuzz_check.out 2>/tmp/fuzz_check.err; rc=$?; echo RC=$rc; tail -50 /tmp/fuzz_check.err` executed with exit code -1.
